data.name: Ewell
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘eol’ meaning ‘spring’ or ‘well’, Ewell is a name of Old English origin. This name symbolizes the refreshment, renewal, and abundance that come from a well or spring. In the Bible, Ewell may be reminiscent of the well in the story of Jacob and Rachel, or the well in the parable of the Good Samaritan.
